entity.name: OLL4 (INTRATRADE SINGLE MEMBER P.C.)
entity.description: OLL4 is the founder-led systems company of Nikolaos Theodoropoulos (INTRATRADE SINGLE MEMBER P.C., Greece; based in Bangkok). It builds and maintains SpaceApp, an open-source (MIT) self-hosted workspace where AI agent CLIs work side by side, with safety the system enforces rather than the prompt.

projects.name: SpaceApp
projects.description: Open-source (MIT) self-hosted AI agent workspace: agent CLIs such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Gemini work side by side in persistent rooms with live terminals, a managed browser and files. Its protections are enforced by the system, not the prompt: an agent-blind vault (an agent asks the vault to fill a login and never sees the password), server-side human approval gates for payments, deletions, releases and messages, and an audit log. One-command install on Linux, Windows 11 and macOS: npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install.
